column1: # Mineral dissolution rate constants from Palandri and Kharaka (2004), USGS Open-File Report
# 2004-1068 (public domain), as transcribed in PHREEQC's phreeqc_rates.dat (RATE_PARAMETERS_PK).
# One row per mechanism: k25 in mol m-2 s-1 at 25 C, activation energy E in kJ/mol, and the
# activities (fugacity for CO2(g)) the mechanism depends on, as species:exponent.
# pk_name is the name in the compilation; mineral is the name in this database.
# Kyanite's acid activation energy is printed as -53.9 there; +53.9 is used here.
